name: an_offer_you_cant_refuse_countering_your_own_spell_gives_you_the_treasures
notes: Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell. Its controller creates two Treasure tokens.' 'Its controller' is the countered spell's controller, whoever cast the Offer: seat 0 casts Giant Growth at its own Bear and answers it with its own An Offer You Can't Refuse. Giant Growth is countered (Bear stays 2/2) and seat 0 creates two Treasure tokens (seat 1 gets none). Seat 0 then casts two more Giant Growths with the Treasure mana alone (Bear 8/8), which works only if seat 0 controls both; both are sacrificed, none is left.
